title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer for part:360020 under ctr:4600070620.

On volumes: we plan 20000 pc per year and offer a multi-year commitment of 24 or 36 months, as set out in the attached term sheets. You told us in June that multi-year volume agreements are what changes prices. This commitment gives you planning security and removes the workload of a yearly renewal.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Which of the attached packages suits you best? Is there a cheaper variant of the 6306-2Z C3 you could offer at the same 7-day lead time?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. However, we appreciate your proposal and the prospect of a 36-month commitment, which provides valuable planning security.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative option, we can offer €4.88 for a 36-month contract with 30 days payment terms, and our technical team will address your question regarding alternative variants. This alternative package offers a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020) – revised 36-month package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the revised offer and for valuing the 36-month commitment.

We have moved a clear step towards you on price. The attached term sheet keeps your lead structure: 60 days payment, 36 months, 20000 pc per year. That is 60000 pc over the term, with no yearly renewal effort for your team.

In June your owner offered to walk us through your calculation of hourly rates and material. We would welcome that, so we can settle the price on a shared basis.

We also look forward to your technical team's answer on a cheaper material grade at the same 7-day lead time.

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020) – revised 36-month package
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer; however, we must maintain our price of €4.91 for the 36-month contract with 60 days payment terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, valid for 7 days.

We would be pleased to arrange a meeting to discuss our cost calculations as suggested. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Regarding the cheaper material grade, we require your engineering approval and a new drawing revision to confirm the 7-day lead time.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
